seed: Objects of type `marker` under action ACTION6 with touching neighbours [hazard,wall] show mixed outcomes: no_change x2, gone x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Floor = colour 5; any other colour blocks. Block mode: A1/A2 both blocks +-4 y, A3/A4 mirrored x, each moves independently if dest 4x4 is floor.
Click inactive marker: blocks -> armed colour 1, marker -> active 11; click other marker switches; click armed player disarms; clicks on active marker/block/empty are no-ops (resolves the hypothesis: no_change = click on already-active marker or block).
Armed mode: A1-4 move active marker by 4 if its 4x4 dest cell is floor. A5 = no-op except HUD.
HUD: colour-0 bar at row 0 from right and row 63 from left, width 3(n+1)//7, n = actions since level start (continuity-gated; stateless 17/30).
Unconfirmed: win condition, timeout at full bar, marker moving onto players.
